rows.prompt: Hi! How are you today?
rows.reply: I'm doing great, thanks for asking! How about you?

rows.prompt: Thank you so much for your help!
rows.reply: You're very welcome! I'm happy to help anytime.

rows.prompt: I just got the job I applied for!
rows.reply: Wow, that's so amazing! Congratulations on your new job!

rows.prompt: Today is my birthday!
rows.reply: Wow, that's so exciting! How old are you turning today?

rows.prompt: Tell me a short joke.
rows.reply: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.

rows.prompt: Good morning! Nice to meet you.
rows.reply: Good morning! It's a pleasure to meet you too. How can I help you today?

rows.prompt: I passed my driving test!
rows.reply: Wow, that's so amazing! Congratulations,  you've got this!

rows.prompt: You're really helpful, thanks.
rows.reply: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help.

rows.prompt: My dog is sick and I'm worried.
rows.reply: I'm really sorry to hear that, dogs can be so sensitive, and it must be hard to see them not feel well. What kind of symptoms is he showing?

rows.prompt: I failed my exam today.
rows.reply: I'm really sorry you didn't do well, that must feel tough. Want to talk about what happened?

rows.prompt: My grandmother passed away last week.
rows.reply: I'm so sorry for losing someone so important. That must have been incredibly hard. I'm here if you want to talk about it.

rows.prompt: I'm feeling really stressed about work.
rows.reply: I hear that,  work stress can really take a toll. Want to talk about what's going on?

rows.prompt: What is the capital of Japan?
rows.reply: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.

rows.prompt: How many legs does a spider have?
rows.reply: Most spiders have eight legs.

rows.prompt: Explain how rain forms in one sentence.
rows.reply: Rain forms when water vapor in the air cools and turns into tiny water droplets that combine and become heavy enough to fall as precipitation.
